messages.subject: Error in .mergeAnnotation(input, annotation)
parts:
Hi I am using the latest version of MSstatsTMT updated yesterday.
When I try to import PSM file from PD I got this:

> input.pd <- PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat(raw.pd.test, annotation.pd,
+                                  which.proteinid = "Protein.Accessions",
+                                  useNumProteinsColumn = FALSE,
+                                  log_file_path = 'PD_SQT/pdtomstatstmt_import.log',
+                                  append = TRUE)
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Raw data from ProteomeDiscoverer imported successfully.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Raw data from ProteomeDiscoverer cleaned successfully.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Using provided annotation.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Run and Channel labels were standardized to remove symbols such as '.' or '%'.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** The following options are used:
  - Features will be defined by the columns: PeptideSequence, PrecursorCharge
  - Shared peptides will be removed.
  - Proteins with single feature will not be removed.
  - Features with less than 3 measurements within each run will be removed.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Features with all missing measurements across channels within each run are removed.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Shared peptides are removed.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** Features with one or two measurements across channels within each run are removed.
INFO  [2021-07-01 12:53:39] ** PSMs have been aggregated to peptide ions.
Error in .mergeAnnotation(input, annotation) : 
  ** Please check the annotation file. The channel name must be matched with that in input data.

I attached here the annotation file and the top 10 rows of my PD PSM file.
Could you help me please?
Thank you in advance!!

Salva.
